_readme: Site glossary for en/ of the Immich guide (v2). shared = WoowTech series names and chrome terms reused across the 13 sites (unchanged from the kit seed); terms = Immich domain terms with their zh variants (upstream immich.app/docs and the Immich web/mobile UI wording win); keepEnglish = never translate/rephrase; forbid = words the reviewer rejects; decisions = the binding cross-page wording agreed BEFORE the 12 chapters and 5 hub pages were translated in parallel: every h2, data-nav label, callout label, table header, code placeholder, chapter title and localize substitution. The plain-text twin of decisions is /home/user/out/terms_immich.txt. Existing shared/principles/keepEnglish/forbid seed entries are kept verbatim; Immich-specific ones are appended.
principles: Upstream English Immich UI/docs wording wins (immich.app/docs and the Immich web/mobile UI).
Product names, CLI commands, config keys, file names, hostnames and placeholders stay verbatim; Chinese placeholders become <your-…> style.
US spelling; sentence case for headings, nav and buttons; Title Case for product and WoowTech series names.
Second person 'you'; direct, like a senior engineer onboarding a beginner; no 'In this chapter we will', no marketing adjectives, no emoji.
Callout labels are fixed: Concept: / Tip: / Warning: / Danger:; full-width punctuation becomes ASCII; 第 N 章 → Chapter N; 圖 N-M → Figure N-M.

Immich: upstream wording wins — immich.app/docs and the exact web/mobile UI labels (Photos, Explore, Map, Sharing, Library, Favorites, Albums, Utilities, Archive, Locked Folder, Trash, Administration, Users, Jobs, Settings, Storage space, Shared links). Where the zh gives an English gloss in parentheses (e.g. 語意搜尋（Semantic search）), keep that gloss verbatim even if the docs now use another name.

相簿 is 'album' only when it means the Albums feature; when it means the whole Immich instance or your photo collection (自架相簿, 這套相簿, 相簿牆) it is 'photo library' / 'photo grid'. 最愛／我的最愛／收藏 are all 'favorites'.

decisions._readme: Binding cross-page wording for the Immich guide. If a page can render a phrase two ways, use the form here. h2_by_section = the fixed patterns per section id; h2_exact = every distinct zh h2 on the site (chapters + hub pages) listed in full because they must not drift; chapter_titles = h1 / navLabel / pagerTitle / part (the chapters.json owner copies these); site_strings = brand, subtitle, hub cards, download names, kickers.

h2_by_section.faq: <Topic> FAQ  (e.g. Login FAQ, Upload FAQ, Admin FAQ; sales/prompts/skills h2 常見問題 = FAQ)
h2_by_section.troubleshoot: Common <topic> pitfalls  (e.g. Common login pitfalls, Common app pitfalls; 安全相關卡關 = Common security pitfalls)
h2_by_section.steps: <Number> steps to <verb phrase>  — keep the Chinese number (六步 = Six steps, 五步 = Five steps); 六步安全檢查清單 = Six-step security checklist
h2_by_section.why: chapter-specific; translate the Chinese h2 literally (sentence case), do not replace it with 'Why this matters' (that is the data-nav label only)
h2_by_section.concept: chapter-specific; translate literally. data-nav is '<Topic> basics' unless listed otherwise
h2_by_section.fallback: a bare generic zh h2 uses the STYLE.en.md fixed form: 為什麼要學 = Why this matters / 核心概念 = Core concepts / 實作 = Hands-on / 常見卡關 = Common pitfalls / 排錯 = Troubleshooting / 常見問題 = FAQ / 官方來源 = Official sources

It is code, so it goes through i18n/_proposals/<file>.json only, AND needs policy=localize on those five units (policy.json owner).
